literal: In the ninth month it entered the Southern Dipper.
idiomatic: By September it had entered the Southern Dipper.

literal: The prognostication states: "Transgressing Horn means great war under Heaven;
idiomatic: The gloss reads: a Horn transit means empire-wide battle;

literal: transgressing Neck means there is great arms; the lord of men has anxiety;
idiomatic: a Neck hit signals massed armies and the ruler’s fear;

literal: entering Room and Heart means arms and mourning;
idiomatic: Room and Heart entries mean war and imperial mourning;

literal: transgressing Tail and Winnowing Basket means the mistress of the harem has anxiety."
idiomatic: Tail and Winnowing Basket transits target the empress."

literal: One reading says: "Under Heaven there is great chaos."
idiomatic: Another line simply predicted universal turmoil.

literal: Entering the Southern Dipper means arms and mourning."
idiomatic: Entry into the Dipper again augured war and mourning."

literal: One reading says: "The general makes rebellion."
idiomatic: A further gloss warned of a mutinous commander.

literal: The places it transgressed and guarded are again the field divisions of Yan, Yu, You, Ji, and Yang provinces."
idiomatic: The stars it touched mapped onto Yan, Yu, You, Ji, and Yangzhou—exactly where armies now raged."

literal: In the seventh month of that year there was the battle of Dangyin.
idiomatic: That July saw the slaughter at Dangyin.

literal: In the ninth month Wang Jun killed the Inspector of Youzhou, He Yan, attacked Ye, Ye fell; thereby Yan and Yu became the crossroads of armies under Heaven.
idiomatic: In September Wang Jun murdered Youzhou Inspector He Yan, stormed Ye, and took the city, turning Yan and Yu into the war-torn heart of the empire.

literal: Chen Min again threw the Yang region into rebellion.
idiomatic: Chen Min then ravaged the lower Yangzi.

literal: Liu Yuan, Shi Le, Li Xiong and others together rose from humble status and straddled provinces and commanderies.
idiomatic: Liu Yuan, Shi Le, Li Xiong, and other upstarts from the margins carved out provincial empires.

literal: Empress Yang was repeatedly imprisoned and deposed.
idiomatic: Empress Yang suffered repeated deposition and house arrest.

literal: All were its verifications.
idiomatic: Each event matched the omens.

literal: In the second year, fourth month, on bingzi, the Great White transgressed the Wolf star.
idiomatic: On bingzi in the fourth month of Yongxing 2 Venus crossed the Wolf star.

literal: The prognostication states: "Great troops rise."
idiomatic: Major mobilization was foretold.

literal: In the ninth month the Year Star guarded the Eastern Well.
idiomatic: In September Jupiter stationed in the Eastern Well.

literal: The prognostication states: "There are troops; the Well is again the field division of Qin."
idiomatic: War was portended, and the Well sector still marks the old Qin lands."

literal: That year Gou Xi destroyed Gongshi Fan, Zhang Fang defeated Prince of Fanyang, Xiao, the generals of Guanxi attacked Prince of Hejian, Yong, Yong fled in haste, and the Prince of the East Sea came to meet and kill him.
idiomatic: That year Gou Xi broke Gongshi Fan, Zhang Fang routed Sima Xiao of Fanyang, Guanxi generals drove Sima Yong of Hejian to flight, and Sima Yue of the East Sea intercepted and slew him.

literal: In the fourth month of the first year of Guangxi the Great White lost its course, going from Wings into Tail and Winnowing Basket.
idiomatic: In Guangxi 1’s fourth month Venus wandered off course, sliding from the Wings mansion through Tail into the Winnowing Basket.
